title: (OPT) Keep singleton factored successor targets inline until distinct-child promotion
body:
Actual focused normalizer failure at frozen `a41774c0b3522ea7e13798f1a337b0aa5f35714e` surfaces a physical replay refusal during `factored successor target node` for `catalog_normalizer.tests.test-fixture-enrichment`. The first sticky ledger reports CleanupReplay/HirValidation, requested4520,remaining3917 against the unchanged67108864cap. The amount alone does not identify the inner allocation or establish that this optimization recovers the application.

Source discovery: `src/cleanup_plan/replay/factored/canonical_shared.rs:204–229` stores each label's weighted targets in a fresh BTreeMap<usize,u64>. `weighted_successor.rs:39–52` then builds a separately paid exact Vec+Rc from it. Keep the first target inline and promote to the existing ordered map only on a second distinct child. Repeated same-child moves must retain the original checked_add/overflow sequence. A label is created with its first move; no invented empty-target representation is needed.

Pay the outer label BTree node using the NEW actual value layout, all initializer/receiving/authentication/Result carriers, and both promotion inserts before either actual tree allocation. A larger inline enum may hurt small cases; no universal savings assertion. Keep every original signature, subset, route, comparison and semantic charge for work still executed, and unchanged caps/fuel/no refunds. The singleton finish must use the existing paid exact one-entry Vec/Rc path; many-target sorting/error/Drop behavior stays intact. Retain the complete original independently executable receiver. No backend, ABI, schema or evidence-authority shortcut.

Minimum owning qualification in a large batch: all exact_small_successor widths0..4 and complete old/current receiver controls; singleton/repeated same child, promotion to two/distinct/sorted targets, duplicate accumulation and overflow/later-error order; full six-field diagnostics; exact/short/zero work and bytes and every real acquisition, stale/foreign/restored owner, sticky failures and whole Drop. Record actual allocated/reserved/peak tuples with genuine original baselines and a clearly scoped singleton census. Re-run unchanged original retry/normalizer owners; disclose their actual outcomes.

Distinct from #830's epsilon-only immutable closure sharing, #816's ordinary receiving and #759's lexical factored-replay extension. No current runtime or live-agent token/cost improvement is claimed.
